prior_issue_disposition.generic_rim_geometry: Resolved for this new visible face. The source-first method produces distinctly more source-specific cuts/plate ends than the old sheet. This does not retroactively approve the old180/225-degree drawings or establish unseen rims.

findings.title: Restore the A61 upper-crown/apex offset instead of centering the tree
findings.observation: In A61, the apex and upper crown project clearly to the left of the trunk/lower skirt. The new anchor moves them closer to the trunk centerline. The source-scale comparison shows this even though total height and lower-skirt placement are aligned.

approximate_image_space_diagnostic.uncertainty: Manual outline/blur interpretation, several source pixels. These are projected-image guides, not canonical geometry, exact camera calibration or game dimensions. The early rough17-18px estimate is superseded by this refined20-24px range.

findings.targeted_fix: Keep lower skirt, trunk, tier heights, cut specificity, shading and relative outline width. Match A61’s projected upper-cap body position farther left, with the apex also more left-offset than the body. Use the original pixels as authority. Do not blanket-translate the middle tier based only on the less certain overlap comparison, and do not average A52’s different projection into the A61 source face.
findings.mechanism_limit: The imagery does not establish how much of the offset comes from original geometry versus camera/azimuth. The requested fix is the visible A61 projection, not an invented canonical bend.

next_action: Make one localized source-facing alignment repair on this stronger anchor, then retest it against A61 before generating another eight-view sheet. No further broad rim/material redesign is warranted.
